method.name: DecryptFileToStagedTransform
method.summary: Decrypt a streamed content file into a sibling staging file and compute the SHA-512 digest of the transformed bytes without changing the destination.

method.name: UpdateFieldIntegrityHashMode
method.summary: Apply a field-integrity hash operation selected by its internal input mode.
method.param: Field key whose hash entry is to be changed.
Operation to clear an entry, hash raw input, store a supplied digest, or compute the content projection digest.
Raw bytes to hash or a precomputed digest, depending on the selected mode; ignored for clear and content-projection modes.
method.returns: True when the entry is updated or successfully cleared; false for an invalid key or a suppressed computation failure.
method.remarks: Raw input is SHA-512 hashed; a supplied digest is stored as-is. An empty or missing value clears the entry for modes that require a value. The method does not acquire the data gate.

method.name: UpdateFieldIntegrityHashAsyncMode
method.summary: Apply an asynchronous field-integrity hash operation selected by its internal input mode.
method.param: Field key whose hash entry is to be changed.
Operation to clear an entry, hash raw input, store a supplied digest, or compute the content projection digest.
Raw bytes to hash or a precomputed digest, depending on the selected mode; ignored for clear and content-projection modes.
Token checked while hashing raw input; cancellation returns false.
method.returns: True when the entry is updated or successfully cleared; false for an invalid key, cancellation, or a suppressed computation failure.
method.remarks: A supplied digest is stored as-is, while raw input is hashed in chunks. Content-projection mode computes the current content-integrity hash directly. The method does not acquire the data gate.

method.name: AcquireLocks

method.name: TryAcquireMetaLocks

Receives the acquired synchronization lock state when successful.
method.remarks: Orders objects by the immutable synchronization lock token, then acquires Sync.Meta on each object. Returns false after releasing any partial acquisitions when the full metadata lock set cannot be obtained.
method.returns: True if both objects were locked successfully for direct metadata field comparison.

method.name: TryAcquireSyncLocks
method.summary: Acquire dual-object synchronization locks without using public getters or clone paths.
method.param: The other item participating in the comparison.
Receives the acquired synchronization lock state when successful.
method.remarks: Orders objects by the immutable synchronization lock token, then acquires Sync.Meta followed by Sync.Data on each object. Returns false after releasing any partial acquisitions when the full lock set cannot be obtained.
method.returns: True if both objects were locked successfully for direct field comparison.

method.name: GetSyncLockOrder

method.name: ReleaseSyncLocks
method.summary: Release synchronization locks recorded by TryAcquireSyncLocks.
method.param: The acquired synchronization lock state to release.
method.remarks: Releases locks in strict reverse order of acquisition.
